home.title: Nonprofit organization | Cultured Pearl | Washington
texts: Cultured Pearl wants to spread our message of hope and compassion. We believe that a single action can make a difference in the community, and that collective action can greatly impact the world. Through outreach activities, our team works tirelessly each day to contribute their part to the greater good.

Here at Cultured Pearl, we know that sometimes all it takes to change the world is a little support. Since our founding in 2017, we have been determined to make an impact. The core of our efforts is to give to women.  We bring our team’s fresh ideas and passion to the range of activities we’re involved in. Through all of our endeavors we hope to display the conviction behind our beliefs.
She is clothed with strength and dignity, and she laughs without fear of the future.
Strength and dignity is her clothing and she laughs without fear for the times that are near...

With our organization’s mission always in mind, we strive to find new strategies for dealing with this challenge. Giving money for groceries is something that we take very seriously, and our team is working each and every day to make a positive impact. Contact us to learn more about our commitment to this cause.

With this initiative, our goal is to promote great opportunities and advancement for other organizations that are doing great things for the community. With access to the right resources, people can become empowered by their own abilities and gain the confidence to fulfill their potential. Learn more about our work by getting in touch with our team today.

At Cultured Pearl, we are dedicated to stepping up our efforts in addressing issues and concerns of today. Our seminars focus on helping others to cope with stress, money, health and adversity.  These issues can't be conquered in one seminar, but  practicing the tools given can empower and facilitate progress. We are always striving to make a difference, and invite you to learn more and lend your support.

Every year with a purpose.  Applications are accepted from November 1 through April 30 of the following year.  Please apply.  Check our website, facebook and Instagram page during those times for details.
The Best Me Made By God

about.title: About Us | Cultured Pearl
texts: Strength and dignity are her clothing, and she laughs at the time to come. She opens her mouth with wisdom, and the teaching of kindness is on her tongue. (Proverbs 31:25-26 ESV)   As women of God, we were put on earth to become helpers.  Our vision for Cultured Pearl is to  bring women into God's light through teaching and being.  We will offer seminars centered around God's word to support real world examples of how the bible should be used to approach everyday life challenges i.e finances, time management, counseling, managing home and life and exploring some of the women of the bible.

A cultured pearl is a pearl created by an oyster farmer under controlled circumstances.  Just as cultured pearls, God places us under conditions that he controls so that he can bring us into his light and shape us.  He allows good and bad circumstances to come into our lives to form us into the cultured pearls that we are.  To bring us into his light he allow us to be put in the fire of affliction, persecution, different life events happening in our lives all at once to transform us.  Zechariah 13:9

meet-the-team.title: Meet the Team | Cultured Pearl
texts: Strength and dignity are her clothing, and she laughs at the time to come. She opens her mouth with wisdom, and the teaching of kindness is on her tongue. (Proverbs 31:25-26 ESV).  Sharonda Savoy is a native Washingtonian with a passion to live life to the fullest which means learning all about what God wants from us.  She answered God’s call on her life at the age of 12 at Mount Olive Baptist Church in Washington, DC.  She is currently a member of the Historic Vermont Avenue Baptist Church.  She has been married for 24 years with a loving and supporting husband and an amazing son.  Her full time career is in the IT field where she holds a master’s degree in Networking.

She is currently the partner of 2 ecommerce businesses.  She had a vision to start a non-profit organization while in church one day.  God spoke to her during a women's day conference as she saw the joy on the women's faces as they began to fellowship and learn about God's promises.  On June 26, 2017, Cultured Pearl began its formation.  Sharonda began learning about the promises that God has for women.

Cultured Pearl transforms women by empowering and uplifting through seminars, workshops and honoring women for their accomplishments.  She is a member of the Ladies of Distinction Washington DC Red Hat Society.  Her hobbies are reading, music, travel and working for God.

This invaluable member of our team is trustworthy, honest, compassionate and hardworking.  Rodney A. Savoy Sr., has been with Cultured Pearl since the inception.  He has been the backbone of it's founder and an inspiration.  He spends his time working with the homeless population while supporting Cultured Pearl and is one it's largest contributors.   His sincere and passionate drive to see this organization succeed is immeasurable.  When he signed up to be the Chairmen of the Board his commitment became a blessing for Cultured Pearl.  We are truly grateful for Mr. Savoy and his commitment for making a change in the live of others.
He has a Bachelor's degree in Behavioral Science with a Minor Religion from Midland University in Nebraska.  He has a Master's Degree in Human Services from the International University.
He enjoys his family, football, golf and working out at the gym.

Trina Logan is a Self-motivated Regional Director of a Social/Human Service organization in Washington, DC.  Her career spans approximately 28 years of brokering/coordinating, linking and monitoring services for people with varying levels of need for support due to developmental and mental health challenges.
Ms. Logan is passionate about respecting individuality and supporting people with discovering and connecting to what is important to him or her.  Ultimately, achieving more purpose driven life.
Shawn Pelote has been in the education field for over 27 years. He has served in many capacities that have provided him with a wealth of experiences and knowledge on how to best educate children.

He has spent his entire career working in Urban School Districts and serving as a mentor to children who live in challenging environments Several of his former students have followed on his path and become educators as well.
He holds a M.A. in Education Administration from SouthEastern University and a B.A. in Political Science from Howard University. He lives in Upper Marlboro Md. With his wife and two children.

scholarship.title: Purposeful Life Scholarship | Cultured Pearl
texts: The Purposeful Life Scholarship is designed to assist High School seniors who would like to go beyond the K-12 education.  We are looking for Senior High students graduating at the current school year.  Our scholarships are awarded to those who show against adversity that their faith in God is their strength while showing others a positive influence in a community based setting.  We are awarding 2 scholarships this year.  Click below to download the guidelines and application.

Coming together from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences, our skilled team of professionals is the backbone of Cultured Pearl. Their ideas help shape the direction and mission of our organization as it continues to develop. Read on to learn more about some of our incredible team members.
Cultured Pearl is overjoyed to celebrate and congratulate Kennedy Cordle, our 2025 Purposeful Life Scholarship Recipient!

Kennedy, a shining senior at Bethesda High School, is preparing to continue her journey at North Carolina A&T University, where she will study Construction Management with a heart set on building sustainable and equitable communities.

Guided by her favorite scripture, Philippians 4:13 - "I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength", Kennedy's unwavering faith, prayers, and perseverance have laid a powerful foundation for her future.

We are so proud of the young woman she is becoming, and we invite everyone to join us in celebrating her, lifting her up in prayer and supporting her as she walks boldly into all that God has destined for her.
